design.GGML_MOE_STREAM_CACHE_PARTITION_TAIL_FIL: comma/colon tensor-name filter for tensors inserted into the tail partition, e.g. ffn_up_exps
design.GGML_MOE_STREAM_CACHE_PARTITION_TAIL_SLO: number of slots reserved at the end of g_vcache for matching tensors; nonmatching tensors evict only in [0,n-tail).
design.default: unset tail filter/slots keeps current full-pool LRU behavior
design.lookup: lookup still scans the full cache, so existing entries remain visible regardless of partition

first_probe.scope: calibration France n64 smoke first; no held-out; expand only if smoke beats 2.2 gate-only n64 control

reason: up hot1g gated stream tied because hot up experts shared the same LRU pool as gate and dropped VRAM cache hit rate from 78.3% to 58.5%. A tail partition can bound up hotset damage by reserving a fixed slot range for matching up tensors.
risk: Gate loses 240 slots, so small gate miss increase is expected. The candidate is only useful if preventing up/gate mutual eviction recovers more than this loss.
